title: TLGY ACQUISITION CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: TLGY Acquisition Corporation, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed Form 8-K disclosing shareholder approval of an amendment to its Articles of Association to modify the monthly extension deposit amount from the lesser of $0.05 per share or $25,000 to the lesser of $0.05 per share or $10,000. The amendment allows extension of the Termination Date by up to six additional months, with the first extension executed on April 16, 2026 pushing the deadline to May 29, 2026.
key_points: TLGY held an extraordinary general meeting on April 15, 2026 to vote on the Extension Amendment
Shareholders approved the amendment with 5,406,283 votes for (99.96%), 2,105 against, and 100 abstentions
5,408,488 shares were represented in person or by proxy, constituting a quorum (91.06% of entitled shares)
13,817 Class A Ordinary Shares were redeemed by shareholders exercising their redemption rights
The modified extension payment changed from the lesser of $0.05/share and $25,000 to the lesser of $0.05/share and $10,000
The Sponsors deposited $10,000 on April 16, 2026, extending the Termination Date from April 29, 2026 to May 29, 2026
